mapper.insert: INSERT INTO ai_provider_config (user_id, provider, name, base_url, api_key, chat_model, embed_model, is_default) VALUES (#{userId}, #{provider}, #{name}, #{baseUrl}, #{apiKey}, #{chatModel}, #{embedModel}, #{isDefault})
mapper.select: SELECT * FROM ai_provider_config WHERE user_id = #{userId} ORDER BY is_default DESC, updated_at DESC
SELECT * FROM ai_provider_config WHERE id = #{id} AND user_id = #{userId}
SELECT * FROM ai_provider_config WHERE user_id = #{userId} AND is_default = 1 LIMIT 1
mapper.delete: DELETE FROM ai_provider_config WHERE id = #{id} AND user_id = #{userId}
mapper.update: UPDATE ai_provider_config SET is_default = 0 WHERE user_id = #{userId}
mapper.select: SELECT * FROM ai_provider_config ORDER BY is_default DESC, id ASC
mapper.update: UPDATE ai_provider_config SET is_default = 1 WHERE id = #{id}
